data_notes.simulation_window: 7 reconstructed days at the 2024 annual-average SNF referral rate (55/day).
data_notes.hospital_inflow_outflow: Daily inflow/outflow is not available. Starting hospital pressure uses 2026-11-18 occupancy, and arrivals use 2024 steady-state SNF referral averages.
data_notes.snf_to_hospital: 55 patients/day are allocated across hospitals using 2024 hospital-level SNF discharge totals divided by 366.
data_notes.snf_los: Individual SNF stays drawn log-normally around the Brooklyn census-weighted Medicare mean (41.7 days), 7-100 days.
data_notes.distance: Patients use the workbook's straight-line hospital-SNF matrix.
data_notes.staffing: Staff headcounts use rounded RN/LPN/CNA 8-hour shift equivalents from CMS PBJ; per-patient demand is a facility-weighted Brooklyn average.
data_notes.bed_availability: Available beds use the workbook's corrected census values.
data_notes.patient_mix: Sex, age group, APR severity and primary payer drawn from each hospital's 2024 SNF-discharge mix (SPARCS). Severity sets clinical risk (Extreme high, Major medium) and scales care hours by 0.85-1.25.
data_notes.referrals: Each patient is referred to the 6 nearest SNFs (from a home scattered ~2 km around the hospital) that have the required bed type.
data_notes.special_needs: About 1% need a ventilator bed and 3% dialysis (assumption).
